info.title: Mutuals API
info.description:
The personal people CRM for the agentic era. Every operation the UI performs is one operation here; the web app, a CLI and an MCP server are all clients of this surface.

Lists take the filter model in `?filter=` as one URL-encoded JSON array. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a per-field `errors` array.

get.summary: List contacts with the full filter model

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON array of filter conditions, ANDed together. Example: [{"field":"city","op":"contains","value":"Munich"}]

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: field:direction, e.g. "display_name:asc". Unsortable fields are refused with 400.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated slugs, in display order. Also scopes the ?q= substring search.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring search over the record label and the text columns named by "columns".

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: The saved view this URL was opened from.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque. Take it from page.cursor of the previous response; never build one.

post.summary: Create a contact and its attribute values in one transaction

get.summary: One contact, with every attribute value

patch.summary: Edit a contact. Last write wins; `updated_at` comes back on every response.

delete.summary: Delete a contact. Facts, values, links, identifiers and follow-ups cascade.

post.summary: Delete many contacts, reporting per item
Set one attribute on many contacts. `value: null` clears it.

Fix a cell in the Review grid, or decide what to do with a flagged duplicate

get.summary: Every user-defined field, with the "Used in N records" count

post.summary: Create a field. No DDL runs; it is filterable and sortable on the next request.

delete.summary: Delete a field and every value of it. Facts, values and links cascade.
